definitions.explanation: An elegant, refined quality that reflects good breeding, sophistication, and moral character. Often used to describe people with cultured manners or things with tasteful elegance.

examples.japanese: {品格|ひんかく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{振|ふ}る{舞|ま}い→振る舞い：10520_furumai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{品格|ひんかく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is grace in her manners.

examples.japanese: ⟦{国家|こっか}→国家：02760_kokka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{品格|ひんかく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{国民|こくみん}→国民：02757_kokumin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{示|しめ}される→示す：01948_shimesu⟧。
examples.english: A nation's dignity is demonstrated by the conduct of its people.

notes:
NUANCE: {品格|ひんかく} suggests refined elegance with moral undertones. It implies both external grace and inner character. The book「⟦{国家|こっか}→国家：02760_kokka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{品格|ひんかく}」(The Dignity of the Nation) made this term widely discussed in the 2000s.
